blurb: Rooted in history and charm, Mañana Resort and Marina offers over 2,000 linear feet of guest moorage, a boutique inn, and spectacular seaside dining overlooking Ladysmith Harbour. This Waterfront Resort also boasts a beautiful Vancouver Island outdoor event space ideal for unforgettable gatherings. Whichever transport mode you choose or the purpose of your visit, you are sure to want to linger longer at Mañana
